neutron-drip-line-definition-0d4eff6b.interpretation: The limit where the nucleus can no longer bind an additional neutron, essential for bounding the r-process path.

electron-wavelength-potential-0c1249cb.title: Accelerated Electron Wavelength
electron-wavelength-potential-0c1249cb.interpretation: Calculates the non-relativistic de Broglie wavelength of an electron accelerated through a macroscopic electrostatic potential.
electron-wavelength-potential-0c1249cb.symmetry_origin: The exact equivalence of electrical potential work to the non-relativistic kinetic energy of the fermion.
electron-wavelength-potential-0c1249cb.limits_and_boundary: Fails at accelerating potentials exceeding ~10 kV, necessitating the inclusion of the relativistic Lorentz factor.

alfven-velocity-characteristic-scale-f96.title: Alfvén Velocity
alfven-velocity-characteristic-scale-f96.interpretation: Defines the characteristic speed at which magnetic disturbances (Alfvén waves) propagate along field lines, proportional to the tension and inversely proportional to the inertia.
alfven-velocity-characteristic-scale-f96.symmetry_origin: The transverse restoring force provided by magnetic tension in a conducting fluid.
alfven-velocity-characteristic-scale-f96.limits_and_boundary: Determines the timescale for magnetic signal propagation in stellar coronas and galactic disks.

semiconductor-mass-action-law-fd2ec158.title: Law of Mass Action (Carriers)
semiconductor-mass-action-law-fd2ec158.interpretation: Describes the equilibrium relationship between electron (n) and hole (p) concentrations in a semiconductor, where the product is a constant for a given temperature and band gap, independent of doping levels.
semiconductor-mass-action-law-fd2ec158.symmetry_origin: The grand canonical ensemble statistics for a matter-wave manifold with a forbidden energy gap.
semiconductor-mass-action-law-fd2ec158.limits_and_boundary: In the intrinsic limit ($n=p$), the carrier concentration is determined strictly by the thermal excitation across the gap.
